name: Cheat Curl
description: A barbell curl variation that uses a slight body swing to initiate the movement, allowing the lifter to use heavier loads than a strict curl. The overloaded eccentric phase provides a strong hypertrophy stimulus for the biceps as the weight is lowered under control, making cheat curls a classic bodybuilding technique.

execution.starting_position: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, arms extended down. Feet shoulder-width apart.
execution.setup_instructions: Pick up a barbell heavier than you would use for strict curls. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and core engaged.
steps: Step 1: Use a slight hip and knee dip to initiate momentum and swing the bar upward.
Step 2: Continue the curl motion, bringing the bar to the chest.
Step 3: Lower the bar very slowly and under strict control over 3 to 4 seconds.
Step 4: At the bottom, use the next swing to begin the following rep.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the curl. Inhale slowly during the controlled eccentric descent.
common_mistakes: Excessive body English that turns the movement into a full-body swing
Not controlling the eccentric — the eccentric is the purpose of the exercise
safety_considerations: The weight should be heavier than a strict curl but not so heavy that form completely breaks down
Do not use this technique as a crutch — it is a deliberate advanced technique
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of curl at the top. Fully extend at the bottom before the next rep.
coaching_cues: Use the momentum to get it up
Take your time on the way down
